Bug_Title: "@SpringBootApplication" and "@ComponentScan" should not be used in the default package
Bug_Explanation: The @ComponentScan and @SpringBootApplication annotations are used in the default package, causing the entire classpath to be scanned which can slow down the start-up of the application and make it fail to start with a BeanDefinitionStoreException.
